review.title: YL-JM2C species-reference GTDB correspondence: scoped M5 diagnostic
review.independence_basis: Authored source proof and bounded correction. Parent independently inspected primary ANI/BioProject passages, NCBI species identity, the exact crosswalk row, candidate diff, shared native writer and controls before actual M5 application.
review.summary: The paper supports identifying stock YL-JM2C as Rhizorhabdus wittichii. The unchanged NCBI species identifier maps through the pinned native crosswalk to the same GTDB species, with seven reference genomes and rounded fraction 0.86. This adds a species-reference correspondence; it does not certify that the study stock's genome belongs to that GTDB cluster. Actual application, native history and eight required commands are bound.
review.scope_description: One GTDB species-reference block, grounding status, source identity and bounded actual provenance; preserve the rest of the scientific record.
review.selection: One complete record, CommunityMech:000554, selected as the first species-reference and shared-runner canary after exact-strain 000555. No wider batch execution preceded this end-to-end canary.
limitations: Scoped technical/provenance assessment with scientific_review:false; no full scientific record approval or corpus QC completion.

The seven-genome crosswalk population is keyed to species NCBITaxon:160791, not stock YL-JM2C or BioProject PRJNA1397584. Membership of that stock in the GTDB species cluster was not independently established. The rounded fraction 0.86 is retained without inventing a support-genome numerator.
Local NCBI label/rank query output is retained; the complete SQLite database and release were not hash-certified. Exact source cache, crosswalk and resolver bytes are bound separately.
The source's earlier Sphingomonas-to-Rhizorhabdus stock reassignment is preserved. Native is_reclassified:false only compares current canonical and GTDB names.
The open RwTfdB structural-determinants discussion and all prior biological claims remain unchanged; this diagnostic does not answer that scientific question.

Seven native scoped validators plus native history scaffolding passed. Source-snippet matching, generated pages, the strict historical successor integration and final combined full QC remain separately accounted work.

records.label: YL-JM2C species-reference correspondence and retained stock boundary

evidence.locator: Results, retained main-text offset 22937; Data availability offset 50466
evidence.summary: The inspected paper reports approximately 97% ANI between YL-JM2C and R. wittichii RW1 and identifies the complete study-stock assembly by BioProject PRJNA1397584. This supports the paper's species identification, not an independent GTDB classification of that stock.

The local authority labels NCBITaxon:160791 Rhizorhabdus wittichii at species rank. Exact pinned crosswalk row 7583 reports seven genomes and fraction 0.86, and the native ncbi_id resolver reproduces GTDB:s__Rhizorhabdus_wittichii. No exact YL-JM2C assembly membership or numerator is inferred.
The actual guarded M5 application persisted only the accepted block, status and two native inline events. The native append-only sidecar and all eight current gate receipts are retained and bound.

evidence.locator: records[id=CommunityMech:000554] and immutable c15s4 deep audit
evidence.summary: Original scientific assertions and the unresolved RwTfdB structural-determinants question remain historical evidence. The isolated baseline retains one community-level node and no inferred consortium cross-feeding arrow; no mechanism claim was changed by this database correction.

assessments.topic: Source stock and species authority boundary
assessments.summary: Preserve stock YL-JM2C, the source's ANI-based species assignment, BioProject and unchanged NCBITaxon species identity. The new GTDB block represents that species-reference correspondence, not a separately verified genome classification of YL-JM2C.

assessments.topic: Exact native species-reference population and name comparison
assessments.summary: Retain native total_genomes 7 and majority_fraction 0.86 from the exact species-ID row, without deriving a support numerator or equating reference genomes with study stocks. Native is_reclassified:false records agreement of the current species names, without denying the paper's earlier stock reassignment.
